Process individual data for histone proteome.

Source: R/histone_epi.R
histone_epi.Rd

histone_epi takes a dataframe with histone mass spectrometry data and outputs a log2-transformed fold change as well as P-values and a T score.

Usage

histone_epi(df, label_col, base_cols, target_cols, ...)

Arguments

df

A dataframe containing histone mass spectrometry data. This dataframe should include measurements for two conditions.

label_col

A column containing PTM/fragment names.

base_cols

A list of columns containing baseline values.

target_cols

A list of columns containing average values for your condition of interest.

...

Optional.

Value

A dataframe with labels, log2(FC), T scores, and P-values

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
histone_epi(df = THP1_single_raw, label_col = "PTM",
base_cols = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5"),
target_cols = c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4", "I5"))
} # }
